scope: Current browsable shots with persisted Cull Swipe human ratings; one JPG/RAW capture group counts once, not a lifetime usage total.

method.pairing: Retained same-shot XMP metadata; paired AI ratings predate human ratings. Staged human verdicts take precedence over delivered ones; pending retracts suppress delivered verdicts. One current capture group counts once.
method.highScoreEvaluationExcludedReason: The author reports many near-duplicate high-score shots taken in quick succession. Rejecting redundant shots does not directly establish poor individual image quality; no burst clustering or deduplication evaluation was performed.

limitations: Personal-use observational sample, not random or blinded; AI ratings were visible during human review.
Unpaired records are excluded from evaluation denominators and correctness judgments.
This snapshot does not establish a reduction in human review time or a general VLM accuracy rate.
A legacy whole-sidecar human write can overwrite the original AI score; a missing retained pair does not establish that AI never scored that shot.
Only one paired example has AI score 1 and eight have AI score 2; their within-range rates do not establish performance on a broader sample.
evaluation: Low-score hit rate only: human outcome falls within the allowed range for AI score 1 or 2; neither exact-star agreement nor a binary reject prediction.

stagingAudit.execution: Operator supplied aggregate output from the read-only audit script.
stagingAudit.consistency: Current human-rating and paired-shot counts match the October 27 check; AI index volume was separately verified on October 27.
